Job Description

As a Software Engineer I here at Honeywell Aerospace team, you will help shape the future of flight by designing, developing, and integrating next‑generation avionics systems for both fixed‑wing aircraft and Urban Air Mobility platforms.  You will play a hands‑on role across the full system lifecycle, from system definition and integration to validation and verification, supporting cutting‑edge avionics platforms. Your work will directly enable laboratory and on‑aircraft testing, ensuring performance, reliability, and certification readiness as these advanced systems move from concept to flight.

LOCATION: Phoenix, AZ
WORK SCHEDULE: Hybrid   Note: For the first 90 days, New Hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite M-F.  

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

Support IMA systems software integration activities
Assist with software validation and verification efforts
Contribute to Key Program Indicators (KPI) tracking and validation
Participate in requirements analysis and decomposition
Support model-based development and system design activities
Assist with integration testing and troubleshooting   
Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE

High School diploma or GED
1+ years of experience in software engineering, avionics, or a related technical field (including internships, co-ops, or academic projects)
Experience with programming languages Java, C, C#, C++, Python, JavaScript, Rust
Experience with Blazor, Docker, Ubuntu, MQTT, REST, .NET, Mongo DB, SQL, HTTP, Bamboo, Bitbucket, Artifactory, Cloud, CI/CD, Git.
Experience with real-time operating systems (e.g., DEOS, ARINC 653)
Experience with  Jira, Confluence, Agile, Scrum

 

WE VALUE

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as the sciences, technology, engineering or mathematics
Exposure to software development lifecycle concepts and best practices
Exposure to hosting web application on cloud.
Exposure to deployment of web application using dockers, CI/CD pipeline.
Basic understanding of the RTOS and embedded applications.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Self-motivated individuals who take initiative and are eager to learn
Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented, fast-paced environment
Effective communication skills and ability to apply new concepts quickly

 

U.S. PERSON REQUIREMENT
Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident, asylum or refugee status in the U.S, or have the ability to obtain an export authorization.

We are not currently sponsoring applicants for work visas in this job.

 

BENEFITS

Beyond a performance-driven salary, you'll work alongside dedicated experts on technology that's advancing aviation. As a Honeywell Aerospace employee, you're eligible for a comprehensive benefits package that includes:

Employer-subsidized medical, dental, vision and life insurance
Short-term and long-term disability coverage
401(k) match, flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts
Employee assistance program and educational assistance
Parental leave and 12 paid holidays
Paid time off for vacation, personal and sick time

Explore your benefits: https://honeywellaerospacebenefits.com/ 

 

---

ABOUT HONEYWELL AEROSPACE

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

 

ABOUT THE BUSINESS UNIT

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Electronic Solutions develops the avionics, navigation systems, sensors and electromagnetic defense technology that help aircraft perform safely and with precision. Our systems are on board 90% of the world's aircraft — serving commercial aviation, defense and space operators from integrated flight deck platforms with 30-plus years in service to radiation-hardened systems trusted for human spaceflight.

 

POSTING TIMELINE

The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date:   11/10/2026
